With spring in full swing, we’re taking every chance we can to bring meals outdoors. This week, @lideylikes is sharing her Tasting Notes on outdoor hosting: picnic layers, ice cream sandwiches, snack boards, and tabletop finds made for the season.

Picnic Layer: Vintage quilts as oversized picnic blanket for long afternoons outside.

Greek Chicken Burgers with Herby Feta: The outdoor hosting meal I’ll be making all summer, recipe available on @testkitchen's website.

Summer grazing made easy with @teakhaus boards: lightweight, beautiful, and perfect for snacks on the go.

Rice Krispies S’mores: A crispy, marshmallowy take on a classic s’more.

Antiques for the summer table: Endless outdoor hosting inspiration at @trade_secretsct last week.

Blueberry muffin ice cream sandwiches: Made with blueberry muffin sugar cookies and strawberry ice cream, these taste like pure summer heaven. Recipe in my cookbook, Cooking in Real Life.
